observations: Multiple retail boxes for 'MINI SEWING MACHINE SM-202A' are stacked on a shelf.
The box art depicts a small, white desktop sewing machine with purple accents.
Text on the box identifies the model as 'SM-202A'.
The box claims 'double threads and two speed control'.
No actual sewing machine is visible outside of the retail packaging.
A foot pedal and power adapter are illustrated on the box as accessories.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a desktop-style machine with a flat base, not a handheld device.
photo 0 box mentions speed control and shows a foot pedal and power port.
The box does not specify multiple stitch patterns or functions beyond basic sewing.

risks.risk: The internal motor or mechanical timing may be defective.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a line of stitches through fabric.

risks.risk: The power adapter or foot pedal shown on the box may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with all included accessories spread out.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or the item inside may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual machine out of the box.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual machine out of the box.
Video of the machine sewing fabric to demonstrate functionality.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, foot pedal, bobbins).
response.reason: The model SM-202A is clearly identified on the packaging, which is sufficient for a base valuation at the worst-case functional state.
